text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Yukoma Hot Springs, everyone. I 
am Hoshina, the proprietor.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Now then, if I may lead the toast. Wishing 
everyone great success in the New Year—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeers!

New Year's. At Yukoma Hot Springs, the 
sanctuary for horse girl hot spring 
therapy, a New Year's party was held for 
Tracen Academy staff.
choice_data_list:

heating up...)

(Seems the conversations are already 
heating up...)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Great to meet you, Dr. Sugar Lights! I 
read your paper! Pure inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Exaggeration. That was merely... my 
stubborn refusal to give up, my ego. 
Besides, it is still undergoing 
improvements even now.

The wild Tucker Blair, and the diligent 
roboticist, Dr. Lights. She is the creator 
of "ST-2", the robot that serves as her 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly, your deserted island. 
Focusing on "instinct" caught my 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Can ST-2 adapt to the instincts horse 
girls possess? Will that resonate with the 
dormant instinct deep within me and 
trigger further evolution? I am intrigued.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Regarding that, I'll need to judge 
after seeing ST-2's blueprints. Not that 
I'm well-versed in robotics, but by all 
means—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It looks like your conversation is really 
taking off. I've prepared an academy 
laptop, so please feel free to make use of 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: *AHEM*!! Much obliged!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of borrowing this venue next 
time for an on-location shoot with Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've used it before! Though if it's 
dance-related... I'd also recommend this 
other place that has permanent equipment 
installed.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Hello-san really knows her stuff! 
Suzuka-san! Want to look through 
candidates one more time?!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, right over here... There is a 
delicious tavern nearby.

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi & Hello
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. I'd be happy to show you the way if 
you'd like~♪

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, this girl... Young mistress, 
don't go interrupting the guests' 
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, unexpected ideas often emerge over 
drinks. If you don't mind, we'd love to 
hear from you as well, proprietress♪

text_block_list.name: Satake Mei
text_block_list.text:
Speed Symboli! Didn't expect to see you 
here after so long! I have heaps of things 
I want to report to you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I know, standard-bearer of the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. —It warms my heart to 
see successors rising.

Two members of the URA. Day after day, 
they support Tracen Academy students in 
their "challenges".

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, how have things been since then? Are 
there girls chasing our dream?

text_block_list.name: Satake Mei
text_block_list.text:
Well, there are girls showing interest, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Here is the list of candidates.

text_block_list.name: Satake Mei
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Let's see here! ...Fufu, looks like 
things are going to get busy again!

When I stepped away from the banquet 
table, I happened to cross paths with 
Tazuna-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san. Good work today♪
choice_data_list: Good work. Have you been able to rest?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Eh?

Throughout the party, Tazuna-san appeared 
to be constantly moving among the 
attendees. All while discreetly providing 
support...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...You really observe things closely, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry. Right now, I'm having so 
much fun I can hardly contain it♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gathered here is a powerful ally 
to our students.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Drawing out their potential, supporting 
their challenges— and guiding them to 
glory.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When they meet each other and new 
possibilities are born, even greater paths 
will open up.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...That is why I'm full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Because supporting everyone here connects 
directly to the future of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Trainer-san. I look forward to 
continuing to support you as well♪

An unsung hero among those who support 
others. Tazuna-san's dedication and pride 
shone brilliantly in that moment.
